advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.intro: Advanced configuration for operators. These settings are optional — the defaults work for most deployments.
advanced.connectivityDescription: NOMAD periodically checks whether it can reach the internet. By default it probes Cloudflare's utility endpoint with a few fallbacks. Set a custom endpoint below if your network blocks the defaults. Leave blank to use the built-in defaults.
advanced.envOverrideMessage: The INTERNET_STATUS_TEST_URL environment variable is set and takes precedence over this setting. Remove it to manage the test URL here.
advanced.testUrlHelp: A single http(s) URL used to check connectivity. Any HTTP response counts as online.
advanced.errorProtocol: Test URL must use http or https.
advanced.errorInvalid: Test URL must be a valid URL (e.g. "https://example.com").

privacy.title: Privacy Statement
privacy.intro: Project NOMAD is designed with privacy as a core principle:
privacy.telemetry: Zero Telemetry: NOMAD does not collect, transmit, or store any usage data, analytics, or telemetry.
privacy.localFirst: Local-First: All your data, downloaded content, AI conversations, and notes remain on your device.
privacy.noAccounts: No Accounts Required: NOMAD operates without user accounts or authentication by default.
privacy.networkOptional: Network Optional: An internet connection is only required to download content or updates. All installed features work fully offline.

content.title: Content Disclaimer
content.p1: Project NOMAD provides tools to download and access content from third-party sources including Wikipedia, Wikibooks, medical references, educational platforms, and other publicly available resources.
content.p2: Crosstalk Solutions, LLC does not create, control, verify, or guarantee the accuracy, completeness, or reliability of any third-party content. The inclusion of any content does not constitute an endorsement.
content.p3: Users are responsible for evaluating the appropriateness and accuracy of any content they download and use.

medical.title: Medical and Emergency Information Disclaimer
medical.p1: Some content available through NOMAD includes medical references, first aid guides, and emergency preparedness information. This content is provided for general informational purposes only.
medical.notSubstitute: This information is NOT a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment.
medical.i1: Always seek the advice of qualified health providers with questions about medical conditions.
medical.i2: Never disregard professional medical advice or delay seeking it because of something you read in offline content.
medical.i3: In a medical emergency, call emergency services immediately if available.
medical.i4: Medical information may become outdated. Verify critical information with current professional sources when possible.

storage.title: Data Storage
storage.intro: All data associated with Project NOMAD is stored locally on your device:
storage.appData: Application Data: Stored in Docker volumes on your local system
storage.outro: You maintain full control over your data. Uninstalling NOMAD or deleting these directories will permanently remove all associated data.

coreAuto.title: Automatic Core Updates
coreAuto.disabledDefault: Automatic core updates were disabled after repeated failures.
coreAuto.description: Automatically install minor and patch updates during your chosen window. Major versions always require a manual update due to their potentially breaking nature.
coreAuto.cooloffHelp: Delay after a release is published
coreAuto.noEligible: No eligible update — system is current or the latest release is a major version / still in cool-off.

appAuto.title: Automatic App Updates
appAuto.description: Automatically install minor and patch updates for apps you've opted in (toggle each app in Supply Depot). Major versions always require a manual update. Uses the same update window and cool-off period as the core schedule above.
appAuto.failed: Failed to update app auto-update setting.
appAuto.none: No apps are opted in yet. Enable auto-update on individual apps from the Supply Depot.

contentAuto.title: Automatic Content Updates
contentAuto.disabledDefault: Automatic content updates were disabled after repeated failures.
contentAuto.description: Automatically download newer versions of your installed Information Library content (ZIM files) and maps during your chosen window. Content downloads can be very large, so set a per-window data cap to limit how much is pulled at once. We recommend allowing at least 0.5 GB per update window to ensure most updates can be pulled in a timely manner, but you can set a lower cap if you have very limited bandwidth and don't mind some updates being skipped (they will still appear in the UI and can be updated manually). If an update repeatedly fails to download within the window, it will be automatically disabled and require manual intervention to re-enable.
contentAuto.cooloffHelp: Delay after a new version appears
contentAuto.toggleFailed: Failed to update content auto-update setting.
contentAuto.invalidCap: Data cap must be 0 or a positive number of GB.
contentAuto.saveFailed: Failed to save content update schedule.
contentAuto.summaryCapped: {{start}}–{{end}} ({{window}}); cool-off {{hours}}h; data cap {{cap}} ({{used}} used this window).
contentAuto.allUpToDate: All installed content is up to date. New versions will appear here when detected.
contentAuto.skipped: Skipped — exceeds data cap, update manually

gpu.reinstalled: {{name}} is being reinstalled with GPU support. This page will reload shortly.
gpu.reinstallBody: This will recreate the {{name}} container with GPU support enabled. Your downloaded models will be preserved. The service will be briefly unavailable during reinstall.
gpu.amdUnsupported: Your system has an AMD GPU, but {{name}} is running on CPU only. Reinstalling won't fix this: the GPU{{target}} isn't on ROCm's supported list and needs a GFX version override.
gpu.amdMissing: Your system has an AMD GPU, but {{name}} can't access it. AI is running on CPU only, which is significantly slower.
gpu.nvidiaMissing: Your system has an NVIDIA GPU, but {{name}} can't access it. AI is running on CPU only, which is significantly slower.
gpu.saveFailed: Failed to save the GFX override: {{error}}
gpu.overrideIntro: ROCm ships GPU kernels for a fixed list of AMD chips. Integrated Radeon GPUs outside that list run on CPU unless ROCm treats them as a supported chip, set through HSA_OVERRIDE_GFX_VERSION.
gpu.chip680: Radeon 680M / 660M and other RDNA 2 iGPUs (gfx1031 to gfx1036): 10.3.0
gpu.detectedRecommended: Detected GPU: {{gpu}}. Current override: {{override}}. Recommended for this GPU: {{value}}.
gpu.overrideHelp: Saving recreates the {{name}} container with this override. Downloaded models are preserved.
